review_notes: PS-T0IW9-001 (BdVersion byte-stability across probes) is a CLI-determinism contract; proptest repeated-sample (cases=64, runs_per_probe=10) is the only legal binding per verification-lane-policy.md. PO-T0IW9-001 command is concrete (PROPTEST_CASES=64 cargo test --test bd_version_capture --release); the anti-invariant (probe digest mismatch MUST fail, not silently re-render) is non-vacuous. Trusted-base empty; assumption list empty in obligation. Behavior-affecting flag is correct. Accepted.

PS-T0IW9-003 (SchemaErrorClass::parse closed-grammar hostile-input) is a fuzzable canonicalization boundary per verification-lane-policy.md; cargo-fuzz is the required lane. PO-T0IW9-002 -max_total_time=120 -max_len=4096 -seed_corpus=... is concrete. Round-trip oracle (parse(raw) -> render -> re-parse(input) idempotent for valid classes; for invalid inputs, parse returns Unclassified without round-trip render) is non-vacuous. Trusted-base TB-T0IW9-bd-stderr-grammar (4096-byte stderr bound) is concrete with verifier responsibility. The corpus path under .beads/vb-t0iw9/seed_corpus/ is acceptable for this config-only bead (writers live under .beads/vb-t0iw9/parsers/). Accepted.

PS-T0IW9-007 (BeadsConfig/BeadsMetadata precedence + cross-mixing) is a cargo-deny-style structural regression gate structurally identical to a fuzz oracle; cargo-fuzz is the required lane per verification-lane-policy.md. PO-T0IW9-003 -max_total_time=120 -max_len=4096 command is concrete. Differential fuzz oracle (corrupt -> reject -> reload original -> round-trip equivalence) is non-vacuous. Trusted-base TB-T0IW9-beads-config-precedence (BEADS_DOLT_* > metadata.json > config.yaml) is concrete with verifier responsibility to inspect rejected corpus entries against documented patterns. Coverage matrix notes 'cargo-fuzz + proptest' but obligation only emits cargo-fuzz; the proptest-equivalent is the dispatch-sandbox capture in PO-001 which together cover the OB-007 surface. Documentation discrepancy, not a blocker. Accepted.

PS-T0IW9-006 (AddSchemaMigration::statement closed-grammar hostile-input; rejects plain-column revival of depends_on_id) is the migrations 0041-0042 STORED-generation contract preservation lane. cargo-fuzz -max_total_time=120 -max_len=4096 is concrete. Round-trip oracle (valid STORED/COMMENTED statements parse -> render -> re-parse identical; plain-column statements never round-trip) is non-vacuous. Trusted-base TB-T0IW9-depends-on-id-stored-generation (STORED-generated in bd v1.0.5 per migrations 0041-0042) is concrete with verifier responsibility to capture bd info --whats-new | sed -n '/0041-0042/p' under .beads/vb-t0iw9/post-repair-verification/bd-whats-new.md. Migrations 0041-0042 STORED-generation contract preserved. Accepted.

PS-T0IW9-009 (post-repair verification re-execution against the live shared Dolt server) is a property-pressure test against a read-mostly CLI surface. proptest PROPTEST_CASES=16 cargo test --test bd_post_repair_verification --release is concrete. The should_fail assertion for the bad-config corpus and the anti-invariant (exit code != 0 OR missing 'Marked vb-qryp7 as superseded by vb-t0iw9 (closed)' flips outcome to VerificationFailed, not silently re-run) are non-vacuous. Trusted-base TB-T0IW9-bd-server-stable (live shared Dolt server at 127.0.0.1:45645 reachable) is concrete with verifier responsibility to capture bd dolt status and pin host:port. Seven verification CLIs are listed: bd dolt status, bd dolt test, bd info, bd migrate, bd sql 'SHOW COLUMNS FROM dependencies', bash scripts/check-beads-server-mode.sh, bd supersede vb-qryp7 --with vb-t0iw9. Accepted.
